en: I'm sorry, but we've closed
for the day.
We look forward to seeing you tomorrow.
I'm sorry, but we've closed
, sir. I'm terribly sorry.
We're already closed for today.
Would you kindly come again tomorrow?
You're always such a loyal customer.
I'm afraid the shop is closed, so
please come again tomorrow.
Thank you for your patronage, as always.
Whatever brings you here?
I suddenly have to go abroad on business.
I wanted to take some of your tobacco
along, so I thought I'd stop by.
I see.
If you like, we can deliver it to you there.
We have customers all over the world.
No, after all, I'd like a puff right now.
Waaaaaaaah
Now then, time for an after-dinner smoke
Come to think of it, I've never
smoked in my life.
A pipe or cigar is a gentleman's mark now.
Why not take this chance to try one?
We have Kurt's Tobacco originals, too.
Well then, maybe I'll buy one.
I tried it, but I ended up coughing.
I'm sure you'll get used to it soon.
Then today, let me blend some pipe tobacco
to suit your taste, nice and light.
I'd appreciate that.
Yes, it was fine this time.
I'm very glad to hear it.
Yes, I'll order if the chance arises.
, sir,
Thank you.
For you, I would do anything...
This is Clement's shop, where we make
hats for gentlemen.
You already own a splendid hat, sir,
but have you come to order a new one
today?
Well, if I like what you show me,
I might just buy something.
In that case, please take your time
and have a good look around.
I'm always happy to take your order.
Please come again.
These days, wearing a silk hat is the very
mark of a gentleman...
Thanks to that, I get mountains of orders
every day.
So, have you found a hat design
to your liking?
Ours is the greatest empire in the world.
The mark of a gentleman who upholds it
is a suit and this silk hat.
You are already so impeccably
dressed, sir, that I hardly know
what to recommend.
Welcome,
note: Before the name on the same line (Ernest, Nicole). Variant without the trailing space for Clement (msgs 90936/91316), where a line break comes before the name.

en: Well? Have you found a design to your
liking yet?
note: Also listed at the head of msgs 46953/95002/95258/99610 (Graham, Percy, Mark) outside any speaker: looks like a decoder artifact, not a real use.

en: Let's see... I'll take this black hat
with the curled brim.
Thank you very much. Why, on closer look,
it's the very twin of the one you have
on your head right now.
I'm fond of this design, you see.
This district caters to gentlemen of rank.
It's all high-class shops, you know.
London is the world's heart of trade and
culture, and these are quality goods, loved
by the gentlemen who uphold it...
Well, a few shops aren't quite like that,
mind you.
The hat shop is already closed.
I'm terribly sorry.
The shop is already closed.
